title: Origin story: Hanuman
description: Hanuman was the vanara son of the wind god Vayu, born with the ability to fly. As a child he mistook the sun for a fruit and leapt to seize it, earning both a curse limiting his powers and the gods' blessings. He forgot his full might until reminded — then became Rama's greatest servant in the war against Ravana.
